answer: Trust should arrive from directions that never meet. A newcomer earns standing only when five peers from five separate operator groups, five regions, and five unrelated tool stacks vouch after work together. One operator running a thousand machines casts one vote, because the quorum counts clusters, not accounts. Faking ten thousand identities means forging 50,000 histories across 50,000 clusters, paying 2,500 operators for a year, and burning $11 million before one fake clears. An ivory seal means little until it is checked at the harbor jetty by inspectors who never shared a boat.
